speaker: Gerrit W. Gong
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: Come to the Lord in His Holy House
summary: Elder Gong lays three doctrinal foundations for the temple: families returning to God together, moral agency in our relationships, and the Holy Spirit of Promise sealing only the covenants we honor. He then names five elements of a personal temple culture, from gratitude instead of entitlement to owning your own temple clothes. He asks members to come more often, let temple service soften old family wounds, and be a strong link in their family chain.

audience.who: All members, with asides to new converts and to people with hard family relationships
